Post.title: Post
Post.description: A social post published on Stylez Hub containing media, links, descriptions, and user reviews.

title.description: The title or headline of the post.

description.description: The rich content description or text of the post.

images.description: List of image URLs or media attachments.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp string when the post was created.

links.description: Array of external action links for the post.

reviews.description: User reviews submitted for this specific post.

NewsItem.title: NewsItem
NewsItem.description: Short community news or broadcast bulletin.

id.description: Unique identifier of the news bulletin.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp string when the news was published.

SocialAccount.title: SocialAccount
SocialAccount.description: Official social platform link for the Stylez Hub community.

id.description: Unique identifier of the social account.

logoUrl.description: Icon or logo URL for the platform.

color.description: Accent hex color for the social button.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when credentials were last updated.

/posts/{postId}.description: Public social posts, articles, and announcements published by Stylez Hub.

/news/{newsId}.description: Public community bulletins and short broadcast news.

/socials/{socialId}.description: Public official social channels and media accounts.

/settings/{settingId}.description: System settings and admin control configuration.
